openQuestions.question: Should the 22 remaining higher-level business testcases (TC-GOAL-1, TC-DRIVER-NEED-1, TC-DRIVER-ZERO-1, TC-ASSESS-1, TC-PRINC-INSTALL-1, TC-PRINC-FREEFORM-1, TC-PRINC-SYNC-1, TC-REQ-DD-1, TC-REQ-EX-1, TC-REQ-IM-1, TC-REQ-SYNC-1, TC-CONST-ELECTRON-1, TC-CONST-WIN-1, TC-CONST-PY-1, TC-OUTCOME-1, TC-TECH-ELECTRON-1, TC-TECH-REACT-1, TC-TECH-RF-1, TC-TECH-ACE-1, TC-TECH-NODE-1, TC-TECH-JRE-1, TC-TECH-PY-1, TC-TECH-WIN-1, TC-TECH-INST-1, TC-TECH-PLANTUML-1, TC-STRAT-WP-1, TC-STRAT-CAP-1, TC-BIZ-ACTOR-1, TC-BIZ-PROC-EDIT-1, TC-BIZ-PROC-EXPORT-1, TC-PRINC-REALENV-1) have their acceptanceCriteria also physicalized to script paths? These are currently descriptive text, causing validation failures.
openQuestions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, they should each point to a test script. However, many of these are composite business-level tests that are satisfied by the app-concern-level tests passing. The Implementation Design recommends mapping them to aggregate test scripts that run the app-concern tests and verify overall outcomes, to be created during TASK-14.
openQuestions.reason: The architecture test runner requires all acceptanceCriteria to be script paths. Leaving them as descriptive text causes 30 validation errors. The recommendation is to physicalize during TASK-14 when the app-concern tests exist.

openQuestions.question: Should the existing Python tests (tests/activity/, tests/sequence/, tests/e2e/) be retained, modified, or removed after the Python backend is stripped?
openQuestions.recommendedAnswer: Remove or archive tests that validate removed endpoints. Retain only the render endpoint tests. Update conftest.py to point to the new minimal Flask app.
openQuestions.reason: The existing tests validate the Flask web app's ~40 manipulation endpoints. After stripping to only /render and /renderPNG, the majority of tests become invalid.

notes: Changes applied to SystemArchitecture.json during Implementation Design: Updated acceptanceCriteria for 8 elements' testcases (app-concern-a through app-concern-g, biz-service-editing) to point to physical test script paths. The 30 remaining testcases (business-level) still have descriptive acceptanceCriteria. The ImplementationToCodingHandoff.json openGaps section documents this as a known gap to be resolved in TASK-14.
